attrs.description: Product map grid projection: EPSG code, with additional projection information as HDF5 Attributes
Nominal spacing in meters between consecutive pixels
Nominal spacing in meters between consecutive lines

Mask indicating the subswath number associated with valid GCOV samples. A GCOV sample is only considered valid if it is generated from fully-focused radar samples. If at least one radar sample in the averaging set is partially focused or invalid, the corresponding mask pixel will contain the value 0. GCOV pixels outside of the radar acquisition extent are filled with the value 255
Product version which represents the structure of the product and the science content governed by the algorithm, input data, and processing parameters
Unique version identifier of the science data production system
Processing date and time (in UTC) in the format YYYY-mm-ddTHH:MM:SS
Azimuth start time (in UTC) of the product in the format YYYY-mm-ddTHH:MM:SS.sssssssss
Azimuth stop time (in UTC) of the product in the format YYYY-mm-ddTHH:MM:SS.sssssssss
List of frequency layers available in the product
Indicates if the radar operation mode is a diagnostic mode (1-2) or DBFed science (0): 0, 1, or 2
